notes.content: ABOUT THE MAJOR The Social Welfare major prepares students for positions in a variety of social service careers. The program integrates theory and practice, instills an understanding of the relationship between social welfare and Christian faith and encourages a commitment to social justice and a life of service. Students complete a set of foundational and advanced courses in human development, social policy, social work methods, practice and research and a semester-long internship. Students interested in majoring in social work should complete their prerequisite and foundational courses during their freshmen and sophomore years. Students interested in graduate study should complete PSY 300 Statistics prior to graduation. **Agreement does not include all required courses for the major at FPU** This agreement lists courses that are prerequisites or may be completed prior to transfer to satisfy major requirements. All transfer courses must be completed with a grade of C- or better, and students must complete a minimum of 18 units in the major at FPU. Please contact an academic advisor to discuss the recommended sequence of courses, including courses that may count for both GE and major requirements. To view the full degree requirements, please refer to the Undergraduate Catalog: https://catalog.fresno.edu/index.php .

ABOUT THE MAJOR

The Social Welfare major prepares students for positions in a variety of social service careers. The program integrates theory and practice, instills an understanding of the relationship between social welfare and Christian faith and encourages a commitment to social justice and a life of service. Students complete a set of foundational and advanced courses in human development, social policy, social work methods, practice and research and a semester-long internship. Students interested in majoring in social work should complete their prerequisite and foundational courses during their freshmen and sophomore years. Students interested in graduate study should complete PSY 300 Statistics prior to graduation.


﻿**Agreement does not include all required courses for the major at FPU**

This agreement lists courses that are prerequisites or may be completed prior to transfer to satisfy major requirements. All transfer courses must be completed with a grade of C- or better, and students must complete a minimum of 18 units in the major at FPU. Please contact an academic advisor to discuss the recommended sequence of courses, including courses that may count for both GE and major requirements. To view the full degree requirements, please refer to the Undergraduate Catalog: https://catalog.fresno.edu/index.php.
